headline: Request to amend the City's Welfare Guidelines to match recent changes to RSA 165.
summary: Welfare Director Charleen Michaud has asked the committee to update the City's current Welfare Guidelines. The updates would bring the guidelines in line with recent changes to RSA 165.
items: Request from Welfare Director Charleen Michaud to amend the City's Welfare Guidelines to align with recent changes to RSA 165
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON ADMINISTRATION/INFORMATION SYSTEMS 
November 17, 2026 at 6:30 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Fajardo, Kantor, Bonilla, Kaw-uh, Sapienza 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Communication from Charleen Michaud, Welfare Director, requesting 
amendments to the City's current Welfare Guidelines to align with the recent 
changes to RSA 165. 
Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
